title: Constant derived realization preserves universal coefficient arrows
statement: For any site C of object universe u+1 and morphism universe u, coefficient map q:R→S, and universal derived module arrow d:E→Res_q E', the canonically specified normalizationConstantArrow J q d is universal for exact scalar restriction on fixed-ring module-valued sheaves. Definitions: [def-weil-pbc-derived-normalization-arrows].

source.place: Tags 06YY, 07A4, 0G7E, 098K, 09BV and 0F63; compatible finite derived trivializations, step 6.

proof.text: Construct the exact equivalence from modules over the constant commutative ring sheaf to fixed-ring module-valued sheaves by restriction along the canonical ring isomorphism followed by constantRingModuleRestriction. Construct the constant comparison by sheafifying realizationRingUnit and the module sheafification unit; local bijectivity proves invertibility. The existing ringed constant-realization scalar-extension theorem makes its derived comparison invertible with the stated unit equation.

Check compatibility of the constant comparison with coefficient restriction on constant sections, using the normalization of restrictionIso. Apply mapDerivedCategorySquareIso_hom_app_comp to obtain the exact derived coefficient identity. Universality of d identifies its target with module scalar extension. The ringed comparison and its unit identity make ringedNormalization universal. The exact comparison equivalences induce an equivalence of structured-arrow categories; the derived coefficient identity identifies its image with normalizationConstantArrow, which is therefore universal.

proof_origin.place: Explicit constant-ring comparison by sheafification units; exact-localization pasting and universal-arrow adjunctions, using the existing constant realization scalar-extension theorem.

theorem normalizationConstantArrow_isUniversal
    (J : GrothendieckTopology C) {R S : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (q : R →+* S) {E : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R)}
    {E' : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} S)}
    (d : E ⟶ (normalizationModuleRestrict q).obj E')
    (h : Nonempty (StructuredArrow.IsUniversal (StructuredArrow.mk d))) :
    Nonempty (StructuredArrow.IsUniversal
      (StructuredArrow.mk (normalizationConstantArrow J q d)))
